system.description:
Channelers of the magic of creation, luminaries are philosophers, muses, and healers of the people.


Iconic Luminaries

• Aerith Gainsborough, Final Fantasy VII

• Goldmoon, Dragonlance

• Nynaeve Sedai, The Wheel of Time

• Ophilia Clement, Octopath Traveler


Playing Luminary

Luminary is a high-support healer. It’s recommended that you avoid direct melee.


Action: Cast

Move: Midline/Backline


Training: Influence, Mysticism

features.name: Theurgy
features.description:
You can Cast Spells using Mysticism.


Spells: You learn 4 Spells, one of which must always be Life. You learn 1 other Spell every 2 Luminary Levels hereafter.


Mana: Your Maximum Mana is equal to (4 × your Luminary Level), and the highest amount of Mana you can spend to Cast a Spell is equal to (Awareness + half your Luminary Level, round up). You regain spent Mana when you Rest.

features.name: Radiant Healer
features.description: You get the @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-app.perks.Item.KXp0umL4on7OoRFF]{Assured Healer Perk}, and the healing rolls of your Spells can also Explode on their highest value.

features.name: Overheal
features.description: When you restore HP, you add half your Level to the total HP restored and, if you restore HP that exceeds the Being’s Max HP, you can give the excess to yourself or a Being you can see.

features.name: Ever-Cure
features.description:
When you restore HP, you can chose to end one Status affecting the Target from either Berserk, Blinded, Charmed, Confused, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Sickened.


The number of Statuses you can remove at once this way increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Revivify
features.description: You can revive a Being with the Life Spell if it has been dead for as long as 1 Hour. If you die, you are instantly revived. Afterward, you can’t be revived by this Ability for 1 Day.

features.name: Life-Giver
features.description: Beings you revive are revived at 4 Fatigue if their Fatigue was previously higher, and don’t gain Fatigue from your Life Spell.
